note: Wallis and Futuna has no price level of its own (no World Bank or ICP level, no spatial survey); it keeps New Caledonia's, by the owner's ruling of 28 October 2026 (Wallis and Futuna shares New Caledonia's CFP franc and is supplied through Nouméa).

sources.title: ISEE Nouvelle-Calédonie, the index New Caledonia's level is carried by (world.prices.NC) — kept by the owner's ruling of 28 October 2026: a territory with no price-level measure of its own takes the level of the country whose currency and market it shares
sources.said: New Caledonia's level: 105.132758737421 CFP francs per US dollar (2025), carried from the ICP 2021 benchmark by the ISEE's index.
